newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai metal exchange to cut trading for Deng.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai metal exchange to cut trading for Deng.

text.p: The Shanghai Metal Exchange will shorten trading hours on Tuesday because of the funeral of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange statement said on Monday.

Trading will be conducted as usual from 9 a.m. to 9:40 a.m. (0100-0140 GMT), but the two sessions between 9:45 a.m. and 10:55 (0145 GMT and 0255 GMT) will be cancelled for the funeral. Trading will resume at 11 a.m. (0300 GMT).
Beijing has announced that the funeral will start at 10 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday.
Other exchanges have not yet decided whether or how to change trading times on Tuesday, exchange officials said.
